appAccess.reviewInstructions: No remote account or review credentials are required. Create a local vault with a new master password to review all functionality.

dataSafety.localDataDeletion: Delete records in the app. Clear app data or uninstall to remove the local vault. Delete exported backups from their user-selected locations.

permissionPurposes.android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE: Inherited from AndroidX Media3; observes connectivity state but cannot transmit data because INTERNET is absent.
permissionPurposes.android.permission.CAMERA: Optional, user-initiated TOTP QR-code scanning processed on device.
permissionPurposes.android.permission.HIDE_OVERLAY_WINDOWS: Platform protection for sensitive screens against overlays where supported.
permissionPurposes.android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC: Optional local vault unlock through the operating-system biometric prompt.
permissionPurposes.android.permission.USE_FINGERPRINT: Legacy compatibility permission inherited from AndroidX Biometric for optional local vault unlock.
permissionPurposes.com.passvault.android.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_N: AndroidX Core signature-level permission restricting app-private dynamic receivers.
